Book it

Schedule your appointment

Pick a live 30-minute time and it books instantly — calendar invite, Zoom link, reminders, and confirmation all handled for you.

Self-scheduling is for established HCPS dealers. Not set up yet? Become a dealer — or we'll show you a request option.

How self-scheduling works

  1. Choose an online meeting or a field visit
  2. We show live 30-minute openings in your time zone
  3. Pick a time — it books instantly with a calendar invite
  4. You and your HCPS rep get a confirmation (and Zoom link)
  5. A reminder goes out 24 hours before; it's logged in Dealer 360

Prefer to talk now? Call 937-626-5141.

Request a time instead

We couldn't match your email to a dealer account, so tell us what works and a HCPS rep will confirm and send an invite.
